237:t_100:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
($$ミライ$$... I was neither a good husband nor a good father...)

237:t_100:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
(Damn it...! Thinking about this in the middle of battle... Have I lost my nerve...!?)

237:t_101:0.en:
$$オットー$$
(...We're finished, for sure... A fight like this isn't war or anything at all... It's a punishment handed down by God...)

237:t_101:2.en:
$$オットー$$
(Wh-What was I thinking...!? A soldier forgetting the fight in the middle of battle...!)

237:t_102:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
($$エミリオ$$, $$リヒティ$$, $$クリス$$... Surely I'll soon be... joining you...)

237:t_102:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(...What was I thinking just now...!? Me, a tactical forecaster, giving up before the fight has even begun...!)

237:t_102:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(Is this because of this space...? Or is it the power of that enemy...?)

237:t_103:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
(...Little by little, my will to fight is withering away...)

237:t_103:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
(It's like when I was a child, facing a parent's or teacher's anger, and the urge to defy them faded away)

237:t_103:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
(What is this...? Is it because I'm feeling a primal terror toward that enemy...?)

237:t_104:0.en:
$$レド$$
(I lived as a soldier of the Alliance without thinking about anything... No... Can that even be called living...?)

237:t_104:1.en:
$$レド$$
(The truth is, I have no worth as a living being... I...)

237:t_104:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$'s vital signs show an abnormality. Retreat is recommended here.」

237:t_104:3.en:
$$レド$$
「...No! $$エイミー$$ and the others are aboard the $$クォーター$$!」

237:t_104:4.en:
$$レド$$
「Right now I'm fighting of my own will...! I... am alive!」

237:t_105:0.en:
$$アルト$$
($$シェリル$$... $$ランカ$$... I... my own feelings...)

237:t_105:1.en:
$$アルト$$
(Damn it... What's been going on since a while ago...! Why do I have to be confessing my sins on a battlefield of all places...!)

237:t_105:2.en:
$$アルト$$
(What is this sensation...!? What's happening to me...!?)

237:t_106:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
(I'm sorry, $$キャシー$$... I'm sorry, $$ランカ$$... I probably... can't go home anymore...)

237:t_106:1.en:
$$オズマ$$
(No matter how many times I shake it off, fear of my own powerlessness keeps welling up from the bottom of my heart... This is... the first time I've felt this...)

237:t_107:0.en:
$$ミシェル$$
(Sis... I might not be able to fight anymore...)

237:t_107:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
(My will to fight is draining away... Was I always such a powerless being...?)

237:t_107:2.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Damn it... damn it! $$クラン$$'s fighting too! I can't be the only one losing heart!」

237:t_108:0.en:
$$ルカ$$
($$ナナセ$$... I might never see you again... I don't know why, but that's how it feels...)

237:t_108:1.en:
$$ルカ$$
(I'll do everything I can... But I... Humanity will surely...)

237:t_109:0.en:
$$クラン$$
「...I'm not scared, I'm not scared at all! $$ミシェル$$'s fighting too!」

237:t_109:1.en:
$$クラン$$
「I'm a $$ゼントラーディ$$! I'll shake off a fear like this, just watch!」

237:t_110:0.en:
$$カナリア$$
($$エディ$$... Live on strong, even without Mama...)

237:t_110:1.en:
$$カナリア$$
(This enemy is different from any I've faced until now... Something inside me is afraid of fighting them...)

237:t_111:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
(I no longer fear death... So I have no intention of resisting the despair welling up from the depths of my heart...)

237:t_111:2.en:
$$ブレラ$$
(But, $$ランカ$$... You, at least, I will protect...!)

237:t_112:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Damn...! What the hell are these things!」

237:t_112:1.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Deny it all you want, I'll sing! Don't think you can stop my soul that wants to sing!」

237:t_113:0.en:
$$ガムリン$$
(Captain $$金竜$$, $$フィジカ$$... Lend me the heart to fight...)

237:t_113:1.en:
$$ガムリン$$
(Something has been trying to bind my heart since a while ago...! Give me the strength to break free of it!)

237:t_114:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
(The fundamental calamity... the enemy humanity must stand up against...)

237:t_114:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
(But what is this unfathomable unease...! Is this... dread...!?)

237:t_115:0.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
(N-No...! There's no way I can win fighting something like this...!)

237:t_115:1.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
(...I can't... I can't give up...! I'm fighting to protect $$クェス$$...!)

237:t_115:2.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
(I can't lose...! I'll protect $$クェス$$!)

237:t_116:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(I've tasted despair many times before, but this battle is worse than all of them...)

237:t_116:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(What is this...!? No matter how many times I shake it off, fear keeps filling my heart...! It's... like a curse...!)

237:t_117:0.en:
$$フォウ$$
「I remember this feeling...! It's the same as when the $$サイコ・ガンダム$$ tried to take control of my mind...!」

237:t_117:1.en:
$$フォウ$$
「What is this...!? My heart... is being taken over by fear!」

237:t_118:0.en:
$$エマ$$
(Captain $$ヘンケン$$... I wanted to see you one more time, Captain...)

237:t_118:1.en:
$$エマ$$
(But I'm sure I can't see you anymore... Since a while ago, I can't shake that premonition no matter what...)

237:t_119:0.en:
$$ファ$$
(I'm scared... I've felt fear many times before, but this battle is different...)

237:t_119:1.en:
$$ファ$$
(Is this what despair is...? Somebody... tell me...)

237:t_120:0.en:
$$カツ$$
(I-If I stop moving, I'll surely be too frightened to ever move again...!)

237:t_120:1.en:
$$カツ$$
(I-I have to fight...! I've fought powerful enemies over and over up to now, haven't I...!?)

237:t_121:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
(I haven't been able to stop trembling since a while ago...)

237:t_121:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
(They're different from any enemy I've fought so far... My body... my heart... is refusing to fight them...)

237:t_121:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
(What the hell are they...!)

237:t_122:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「The fundamental calamity... Those who give humanity despair...」

237:t_122:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「But humanity shakes that off and moves forward...! We won't let you rule the future of mankind!」

237:t_123:0.en:
$$クェス$$
(This feeling... It's like when I first met the Colonel...)

237:t_123:1.en:
$$クェス$$
(But it's different...! The Colonel embraced me, but those things are trying to control me...!)

237:t_123:2.en:
$$クェス$$
(Like I'd let creeps like that do whatever they want with me!)

237:t_124:1.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(...No...! Why do I think of such things as my Master...!?)

237:t_124:2.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(Is something inside my heart reacting to the existence of these things...!)

237:t_125:0.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
(Tch... Me, a veteran of a hundred battles, trembling like a raw recruit... Who'd have thought...)

237:t_125:1.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
(What in the world are they... There's something about them that's more than just strong...!)

237:t_126:0.en:
$$コンロイ$$
(Lieutenant Colonel $$ダグザ$$... I inherited your will and have led $$エコーズ$$, but... it may be impossible now...)

237:t_126:1.en:
$$コンロイ$$
(Fighting that enemy, something inside me keeps crumbling away... If this goes on... sooner or later I'll...)

237:t_127:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Behind me... $$ティファ$$ is there!」

237:t_127:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「So I can't lose! Not to you, and not to myself, either, about to scream in terror!!」

237:t_127:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$ティファ$$!! Give me courage!!」

237:t_128:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
(I've been in the middle of battle all this time...)

237:t_128:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
(Someone like me living happily under the young ladies' roof... I'm sure that would never be allowed...)

237:t_128:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
(...But I will fight... If it's a road I can't turn back from, then at least to protect the young ladies and everyone...!)

237:t_129:0.en:
$$シン$$
($$マユ$$, Dad, Mom... I fought to stop war... and in the end, I'm the one waging war...)

237:t_129:1.en:
$$シン$$
(Why do I feel like this... Now I'm just like... a kid who's been scolded...!)

237:t_130:0.en:
$$キラ$$
(I'm sorry, $$フレイ$$... I'm sorry, $$サイ$$...)

237:t_130:1.en:
$$キラ$$
(There are other people I have to apologize to... Why... My feelings are set on fighting, and yet my heart keeps filling with regret...)

237:t_130:3.en:
$$キラ$$
(...Even so, I...! I... will fight...!)

エミリオ.evidence: Gundam 00: Emilio Ribisi, Sumeragi's late comrade; named beside Lichty and Chris

フレイ.evidence: Gundam SEED: Flay Allster; Kira apologizes to Flay and Sai

サイ.evidence: Gundam SEED: Sai Argyle, Kira's friend

マユ.evidence: Gundam SEED Destiny: Mayu Asuka, Shinn's younger sister

エディ.evidence: Canaria's child, addressed with ママ (Mama); Macross 7

フィジカ.evidence: Macross 7 character tied to Gamlin and Captain Kim; romanization unverified

金竜.evidence: Macross 7: Kim Kabirov, Gamlin's captain (Emerald Force)

サイコ・ガンダム.evidence: Zeta Gundam: Four's Psycho Gundam; not in glossary sheet
